findings.basis: Source inspection; this scenario was not executed.
findings.description: The property-accessor exemption suppresses repeated setters and deleters. After recognizing a getter, every subsequent same-name setter/deleter is allowed without tracking which accessor was already defined. Two non-stub setters can therefore overwrite behavior while producing status clean, contrary to FR-971's duplicate-definition requirement. The mirrored implementation has the same behavior.
findings.recommendation: Track accessor kinds and definition lines, distinguishing getter/setter/deleter composition from repeated definitions of the same accessor.
